Tree view

Source: R/v2-tree.R
shad_tree.Rd

A file-explorer tree (APG TreeView) with keyboard navigation, single or multiple selection, and optional lazy branches. A bound Shiny input: input$<inputId> is the character vector of selected keys. Expanding a lazy branch fires input$<inputId>_expanded (a list with key, expanded, and a nonce); answer it with update_shad_tree(children=). Compose from shad_tree_item().

Usage

shad_tree(
  inputId,
  ...,
  selected = NULL,
  selection = c("single", "multiple"),
  label = "Tree",
  class = NULL
)

Arguments

inputId

Input id.

...

shad_tree_item() entries, plus optional named attributes.

selected

Character vector of initially selected keys.

selection

"single" (default) or "multiple".

label

Accessible label for the tree.

class

Extra CSS classes.

Value

A tree tag, bound as a Shiny input.

See also

Other shadshiny flow: shad_dropzone(), shad_number_input(), shad_rating(), shad_step(), shad_stepper(), shad_tree_item(), update_shad_number_input(), update_shad_rating(), update_shad_stepper(), update_shad_tree()

Examples

shad_tree(
  "files",
  shad_tree_item("src", "src", expanded = TRUE,
    shad_tree_item("src/app.R", "app.R"),
    shad_tree_item("src/utils.R", "utils.R")
  ),
  shad_tree_item("data", "data", lazy = TRUE)
)
